paper.title: A Unified Framework for Coordinated Multi-Arm Motion Planning
paper.venue: The International Journal of Robotics Research (IJRR)

provenance_notes: Repository identity, default branch, SPDX license and HEAD commit come from the GitHub REST API as captured in .work/p5/api/. `SinaMirrazavi/*` and `sinamr66/*` resolve to the same repositories (the account was renamed; GitHub 301s the old paths).
Source snapshots are codeload tarballs of the default branch at the recorded HEAD; sha256 is over the tarball bytes as downloaded during this session.

Two repositories (ML_toolbox, kuka-rviz-simulation) were deliberately not snapshotted because they are out of scope for the numerical reproduction; they are recorded as METADATA_ONLY rather than silently omitted.
No file in this manifest is vendored into the reproduction repository. See license_policy.

repositories.head_commit_message:
Merge pull request #1 from salmanfaraji/patch-1

Update README.md
repositories.role_in_paper: Single-DS multi-arm behaviour generator; coordination allocation tau and virtual-object dynamics.
blockers: ROS package (catkin) with a hard dependency on SESODS_lib and ML_toolbox; not a standalone library.
calculate_coordination_allocation() implements a variant of (8) (DIVERGENT from the printed equation); see P5_EQUATION_AUDIT.md O2.
calculate_u() uses U = -A^T X instead of the paper's U_i = tau * dot{x}^V (DIVERGENT); see O1.

repositories.role_in_paper: Standalone LPV/GMR DS solver: builds A_ik and theta_k, integrates the DS.
blockers: Depends on ML_toolbox (GMR) and Eigen; CMakeLists assumes a ROS/catkin context.
No test target and no golden data; correctness must be re-established numerically (P5-T02).

repositories.role_in_paper: Centralised velocity-level QP inverse kinematics with LVI projection dynamics.
blockers: CVXGEN-generated solver sources are absent from the repository; the QP backend does not exist in the snapshot.
get_gamma() is declared/called but never defined.
Gamma_ / DGamma_ are never updated: the SCA path is dead code, so (17d) is structurally present but numerically inert.
Omega_projector() has a return-value defect (returns its input); (21b) therefore cannot produce the projected iterate as published.

repositories.role_in_paper: Generates the labelled 36-D SCA dataset (free vs collision) used to train the boundary.
blockers: Requires a robot model (KUKA LWR via kuka-rviz-simulation / ROS) to evaluate distances.
Random sampling configuration does not reproduce the paper's stated sampling count; see P5_PAPER_STUDY.md section 8.4.

repositories.role_in_paper: Trains the RBF-SVM SCA boundary and performs CPSP support-vector pruning.
blockers: Trained models ship with the repository, but the training sets do not; retraining is not reproducible from this repo alone.
MATLAB + mex libsvm toolchain required.
No license file: redistribution of models is legally unclear (see license_policy).

repositories.head_commit_message: Revert "Clean the branch to only have a c++ library"
repositories.role_in_paper: Analytical gradient of the RBF-SVM decision function w.r.t. the query point: implements (25).
blockers: README gradient formula is missing a factor of 2 relative to a direct differentiation of the RBF kernel; the code is the authority, the README is wrong.
Bundled training data is large (170 MB) and partially duplicated.
No license file.

repositories.role_in_paper: Second-order DS library used by Multiarm_ds for the underlying single-arm dynamics.
blockers: Repository name in the paper's project page is misspelled `SESOSDS_lib`; the live repository is `SESODS_lib` (the misspelling 404s).
MATLAB-only, no automated tests, large binary model set.

executability_summary.headline: 0 of 9 repositories run out of the box. 3 build after patching, 1 is model-only, 1 is partial, 1 (the QP backend, i.e. the paper's core solver) cannot execute at all because the CVXGEN sources are missing and the SCA path is dead code.

license_policy.principle: read for understanding, never vendor, never copy code into this repository
license_policy.consequence: The four repositories that matter most for the numerical reproduction (QP_IK_solver, Multiarm_ds, SCA-Boundary-Learning, SVMGrad) are either LGPL-3.0 or carry no license at all. Any P5 implementation must therefore be a clean-room re-derivation from the paper's equations, not a port. Only numeric constants, file-format facts, and behavioural observations may be carried over.
license_policy.model_artifacts: Trained .mat models are treated as opaque binary reference data for comparison only; they are not committed to this repository.
